result.topic_en: Pencil calculations of a Weber-type electrodynamic interaction between two charges $\varepsilon, \varepsilon'$ at distance $r$, involving $(\partial r/\partial t)^2$, $r\,\partial^2 r/\partial t^2$ and the squared relative velocity divided by $cc$, together with an iterated Laplace operator, a circle diagram and unrelated ink doodles.
result.transcription:
$\varepsilon\varepsilon' \frac{\left(\frac{\partial r}{\partial t}\right)^2}{r}$ \quad $-\frac{1}{r}$

$\varepsilon\varepsilon'\left(-\frac{1}{rr}\frac{\partial r}{\partial t}\left(\frac{\partial r}{\partial t}\right)^2 + \frac{1}{r}\,2\frac{\partial r}{\partial t}\left(\frac{\partial^2 r}{\partial t^2}\right)\right)\partial t$

$f\frac{\partial r}{\partial t}\partial t$ \quad $r\frac{\partial r}{\partial t} = (x-x')\left(\frac{dx}{dt}-\frac{dx'}{dt}\right)+(y-y')\left(\frac{dy}{dt}-\frac{dy'}{dt}\right)$

$\Sigma\ \frac{\varepsilon\varepsilon'}{rr}\left(\left(\frac{\partial r}{\partial t}\right)^2 - 2\frac{\partial^2 r}{\partial t^2}\,r\right)$ \quad $\frac{(x-x')^2}{r^3}$ \quad $\frac{(x-x')(y-y')}{r^3}$

$\frac{1}{r}$

$+\frac{1}{cc}\varepsilon\varepsilon'\frac{1}{r}\left(\left(\frac{dx}{dt}-\frac{dx'}{dt}\right)^2+\left(\frac{dy}{dt}-\frac{dy'}{dt}\right)^2+\left(\frac{dz}{dt}-\frac{dz'}{dt}\right)^2\right)$

$+\frac{1}{cc}\varepsilon\varepsilon'\frac{1}{r}\,r^2\left(\frac{d\varphi}{dt}\right)^2$

$\frac{\varepsilon\varepsilon'}{cc}\,r\,2\frac{d\varphi}{dt}\frac{d^2\varphi}{dt^2}$

$\frac{\varepsilon\varepsilon'}{cc}\frac{d^2\varphi}{dt^2}$

$\left(\partial_x^2+\partial_y^2+\partial_z^2\right)^{2(p-1)}\left(\partial_x^2+\partial_y^2+\partial_z^2\right)u = 0$

$\frac{x-y}{x-x'}$ \quad $f(x)$ \quad $x^2+x+1$ [?]

$\pi c$ \quad $u$ \quad $\pi 2$ [?] \quad $0$ \quad $\pi$
